title: 2009 AMC 12B Problem 5
statement: Kiana has two older twin brothers. The product of their three ages is \(128.\) What is the sum of their three ages?

solutions.text:
Since \(128 = 2^7,\) each age is a power of \(2.\) The twins share an age \(t,\) so Kiana’s age is \(\dfrac{128}{t^2}.\)

Taking \(t = 8\) gives Kiana \(\dfrac{128}{64} = 2,\) who is younger than the twins. (Smaller twins would make Kiana older, which is not allowed.) The sum is \(8 + 8 + 2 = 18.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
